description: Configure the staff profile system (Intros, custom nicknames, and stats).

content.name: enableProfiles
content.description: Allows staff to have a profile tracking their shifts, reviews, and a custom introduction.

content.name: onlyAllowStaffProfile
content.humanName: Only allow staff and higher to have their own customizable profile
content.description: If enabled, only staff members and higher will be able to set a custom profile nickname and introduction. If disabled, all members will be able to set a custom profile nickname and introduction.

content.name: managePermission
content.description: Which group is allowed to forcibly wipe another staff member's profile?

content.name: profileEmbedMessage
content.description: Customize the embed shown when viewing a staff profile.

params.name: nickname
params.description: The user's custom profile nickname (uses default username if not set).

params.name: status
params.description: The user's current status (LoA, RA, etc.).
